name: Misaki Hiro
source:
As normal and average student in original world, he always wonders why he got summoned to the new world as Hero. He appeared in front of Eros when she was trying summoning magic so he gets treated as her familiar after that.

After knowing Eros and her friends can only use magic by holding hand with him, he decides to support them while looking for the meaning of his own existence in this world.
translation:
As normal and average student in original world, he always wonders why he got summoned to the new world as Hero. He appeared in front of Eros when she was trying summoning magic so he gets treated as her familiar after that.

After knowing Eros and her friends can only use magic by holding hand with him, he decides to support them while looking for the meaning of his own existence in this world.
